question: Should durable agent transcripts preserve opaque URL values solely because they are needed for later replay, provided independently recognized credentials and every log/display surface remain redacted?
rationale: This is a deliberate storage-boundary tradeoff between reliable multi-turn replay and retaining bearer-like capability material on disk; source inspection alone cannot choose the repository’s intended privacy policy.

options.title: Approve a narrow transcript exception
options.body: Preserve ordinary name-matched URL query values only in transcripts, while requiring tests that still redact credential-shaped values, structured credential fields, form secrets, and Authorization headers.

options.title: Keep name-based URL masking everywhere
options.body: Retain the existing conservative storage behavior and accept that later transcript replay cannot reuse opaque capability URLs.

options.title: Define a stricter capability policy first
options.body: Pause the patch while maintainers specify which URL-value classes may persist and what transcript-at-rest protections are required.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow transcript exception
recommendation.body: Preserve ordinary name-matched URL query values only in transcripts, while requiring tests that still redact credential-shaped values, structured credential fields, form secrets, and Authorization headers.
